name: PRSet
model_likelihood: Pathway-specific sum of GWAS-effect-weighted, clumped target genotypes; subtype prediction optionally uses a generalized linear model.
prior: No Bayesian prior stated; optional subtype model uses lasso regularization of pathway PRS coefficients.
inference_algorithm: Pathway-wise clumping; size-matched genic-background permutation; for subtyping, pathway enrichment selection, threshold optimization, and cross-validated lasso.
estimand: Individual pathway PRSs; competitive enrichment P-values; supervised subtype predictions.
data_input: Base GWAS SNP effects; target genotypes and phenotypes; gene/pathway annotations; subtype labels for training.
tunable_settings: Pathway definitions and gene windows; clumping parameters; GWAS P-value thresholds; permutation count N; enrichment cutoff; lasso lambda.

name: SNP-Stratifier
model_likelihood: Generalized linear model on selected individual SNP genotype calls weighted by GWAS effects, with subtype labels as the training outcome.
prior: No Bayesian prior stated; lasso penalty on SNP-level predictors.
inference_algorithm: Clumping and thresholding followed by lasso effect readjustment; cross-validation selects minimum-MSE model.
data_input: Target genotype matrix weighted by GWAS effects; training subtype labels.
tunable_settings: GWAS P-value threshold; clumping parameters; lasso penalty; selected-SNP cap (10,000 in study); cross-validation split.
